thresholds._help: Risk = the model's % chance this COD order comes back (RTO). Orders below nudge_from ship as-is.

rules._help: Hard rules that override the risk score. true/false or a number.

prepaid_nudge._help: Flat ₹ discount offered to switch from COD to online payment.

whatsapp._help: brand_name is a placeholder - put the real store name here. Hours are counted from when the first message is sent. No messages between quiet_start and quiet_end (24h clock).

assumptions._help: NOT from data: our best estimates. Measure these in the first 2 weeks (see memo) and update.

llm._help: Used only for address/name judgement and reading free-text WhatsApp replies. Needs ANTHROPIC_API_KEY; falls back to rules without it.
